# Cross-package const folding: a top-level const passed as a prop into a
# component imported from another directory must let the receiving
# component's `for` loop unroll at compile time. The rendered HTML must
# contain the literal text values as static markup, not a runtime loop.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Both unrolled values must appear as static text nodes in the HTML.
grep 'a</span>' out/index.html
grep 'b</span>' out/index.html

# And no JS for-loop runtime should leak into the static markup.
! grep 'for (' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import "widgets"

const items = ["a", "b"]

component main {
    widgets.Row(entries=items)
}

-- widgets/row.sngl --
component Row(entries list<string> = []) {
    for x = entries {
        text(value=x)
    }
}
